acceptance: make pr-arm-remote arms only when all seven arm conditions in docs/agent/remote-closeout.md hold, refuses with a specific reason otherwise, and arms with gh pr merge --squash --auto --match-head-commit
Feature-mode, batch, stacked, and soundness-path PRs are refused
The targets change no working-tree file, local branch, or local Git config, and fetch with --no-tags and auto maintenance disabled
pr-landing-remote-withdraw disables auto-merge for the bound PR; pr-landing-remote-ready re-applies every arm condition to a new head and a new record
Tests cover each refusal, a passing arm, and the withdraw and ready transitions
context:
Implemented and shipped together with the [REMOTE-CLOSEOUT-001] rule in PR #3131 (branch docs/remote-closeout-policy, head 0195cbd4a): tests/unit/scripts/test_check_makefile_inventory.py requires every make target AGENTS.md names to exist, so the rule cannot land before the targets. All acceptance criteria met; fresh-context review found no way to arm a stale or mismatched record; its two Required findings (re-arm without withdrawal, corrupt worktree config failing open) are fixed. Branch feat/remote-closeout-targets is now identical to the PR branch and needs no PR of its own.

Owner decision before arming #3131: the rule grants agents a new permission in the read-only primary clone and its wording differs from the plan text the owner approved. Known gap: live tracker has no registered batches (schema 1), so the local worktree marker is the only feature-mode signal today. The remote path stays inactive until docs/agent/cloud-builder.md lets builders open their own PR (make pr-open now works without GraphQL, PR #3132).
description: Implement the targets that [REMOTE-CLOSEOUT-001] and docs/agent/remote-closeout.md define, so a local closer can judge and arm a cloud-built PR from the primary clone without a linked worktree: a reviewer-record store under ~/.benchbox/reviews/, a PR binding record, make pr-arm-remote PR=N HEAD=SHA enforcing the seven arm conditions, and make pr-landing-remote-withdraw and make pr-landing-remote-ready.
